row.notes: Works on two robin-hood maps of 0x24-byte entries keyed by u32 element hash (source embedded at data+0x538, dst given). Pass 1 erases from dst every key missing in the source (backward-shift delete). Pass 2 walks the source: when global byte DAT_14618e698 is set and the key is not one of 14 whitelisted hashes (DAT_146104d2c..d60) it clears entry byte +0x10 (visibility), then inserts the entry into dst if absent (FUN_1438d7fc0) copying the 0x20 payload. No-op if source is empty (+0x560 == 0).
